upstream_standard_regression.completion_contract: Review actual execution.json passed/returncode, included_cases, reported_totals, difference_files, input_mutations, skips and retained raw logs; do not infer acceptance from selected counts or queue progress.
upstream_standard_regression.completion_note: All four selected suites independently passed with zero failures/skips/differences/mutations: masterCPU183, integrationCPU191, masterCUDA184, integrationCUDA184. Capability exclusions remain unvalidated coverage.

selection_and_comparator_preservation.interpretation: Existing shared inputs and saved references are unchanged; only short/full test lists differ. CUDA selected case names/order match. CPU integration replaces the legacy B3LYP external grid with PBE0-D3BJ/cc-pVDZ plus eight other feature cases: 182 common + nine feature cases =191. The omitted B3LYP case is independently covered in published-ESP16/16. All 12 original check_* bodies, including numerical thresholds, remain byte-identical; runner adds EFIELD/EFG categories/checkers.

actual_scope.note: ESP_CHARGE is unrestrained; RESP/rwRESP require external Amber tools, unavailable here.

published_esp_preservation.interpretation: Preserved within original tolerances; no claim that runtime outputs are byte-identical. ESP_CHARGE remains an unrestrained QUICK fit; external RESP/rwRESP was not executed.

api_derivative_optimizer_lifecycle.pointwise_scope: Water HF/STO-3G, acetone PBE0-D3BJ/cc-pVDZ, ammonium HF/STO-3G and OH UHF/STO-3G; 16 deterministic external probes per case and generated density surfaces (62, 135, 64 and 56 points respectively). Lifecycle mode covers water/OH. Properties share a byte-identical CPU reference density after independently converged initialization SCFs.
api_derivative_optimizer_lifecycle.CUDA_MPI_internal_label_note: gpu_mpi2 in api-cuda-mpi1 is a fixed dictionary key; command -np 1, raw TOTAL RANKS=1 and rank-0 kernel CSV establish CUDA MPI with one rank.

short_bomd_and_gpu_execution.scope: Short trajectory smoke tests. Same-geometry postprocessing uses independently converged CPU SCFs, not an identical imported density. Separate trajectories can diverge at longer times.
short_bomd_and_gpu_execution.GPU_evidence: Positive successful property-kernel launch counters in accepted API and BOMD raw per-rank CSVs; outputs synchronously returned and compared. No new external profiler/performance claim.

external_resp_rwresp.reason: No Amber resp executable is available; QUICK ESP_CHARGE is an unrestrained fit and ESP preservation is only the downstream input contract.

standalone_numerical_grid_CPU_and_MPI.scope: Analytic/numerical EFG dispatch and table agreement on CPU serial and CPU MPI2.

additional_GPU_checks.coverage: Ten optimizer endpoint cases across serial CUDA/CUDA-MPI1; 129-probe finite-behavior stress; four memory/initialization instrumented GPU runs with two CPU references and eight common-density comparisons; eight standalone analytic/numerical grid jobs across two GPU backends.
additional_GPU_checks.range_stress_scope: Finite API behavior and order at extreme observation coordinates; cancellation/underflow stress only, no relative far-field accuracy or reported parity acceptance threshold.
additional_GPU_checks.range_legacy_table_limit: Fixed-width legacy ESP coordinate columns print asterisks at these extreme distances. The finite behavior gate covers API CSV coordinates and scientific properties, not numeric rendering of every printed coordinate column.

limitations: No full gradient arrays exist in the accepted old driver output; finite scalar summaries only, no full gradient parity claim.
